items.why: Citi raised its price target to $800 from $575, betting Meta's Muse agent drives a surge in server CPU demand. CEO Lisa Su also told reporters in Taipei that AMD will substantially increase chip shipments in 2027.
Melius Research upgraded the stock to Buy from Hold with a $665 target, calling Microsoft the trusted "adults in charge" of AI as enterprise safety fears push buyers toward established players.
Oil fell as Middle East exports recovered above pre-war levels and G7 nations moved to release 100 million barrels from emergency reserves, easing supply concerns.
Nvidia closed at an all-time high Monday on strong AI server results from partner Foxconn. Citi reiterated its Buy rating with a $315 target as agentic AI demand builds.

market_note: Futures point higher with the S&P 500 near an all-time high as falling oil and Treasury yields lift risk appetite.
summary: Stocks are powering higher with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq touching fresh all-time highs, driven by a broadening AI rally that is shrugging off a bond market slump. Oil is the outlier, sliding on recovering Middle East supply and a G7 emergency reserve release.
